message: I have this friend, Sarah, who’s just a bundle of nerves whenever we cook together. The minute she hears a smoke alarm, she’s ready to sprint out of the house! 😅 I finally convinced her to do a kitchen safety refresher with me, and it turned into a fun afternoon. We practiced our escape plan and chatted about smoke alarms—turns out, just knowing what to do can really ease those jitters. Sometimes, a little prep goes a long way in making us feel calm and ready. Have you ever had a moment like that with a friend?
